newsitem.title: USA: Ginnie Mae increases REMIC 1996-20 to $228 mln.
newsitem.headline: Ginnie Mae increases REMIC 1996-20 to $228 mln.

text.p: The Government National Mortgage Association said it increased the size of a previous issue of Real Estate Mortgage Investment Conduit (REMIC) securities.
REMIC 1996-20 has been increased to $228 million from $150 million, Ginnie Mae said.
The issue is backed by about $150 million of 7.5 percent GNMA I certificates and $78 million of 6.5 percent GNMA I certificates, GNMA said.
REMIC 1996-20 priced on August 21 and has a settlement date of September 5, the agency said. It was sponsored by PaineWebber Goup Inc and co-sponsored by Blaylock & Partners, GNMA said.
